name: Steps
description: Shows progress through a sequence: an ordered list of steps, each complete, current, upcoming or in error. Compose it from Step children, or pass the same structure as steps.

livewire.name: steps
capabilities: Children: step; steps renders the same children
wire:model binds value; with clickable, choosing a completed step sets it
A step's 2.x step and text props still work, as its number and title

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps as data, rendering the same children as composition: { title, description, state, icon }. state is complete, current, upcoming or error; without it, value decides. icon replaces the marker's number or check.

props.name: value
props.description: The current step, from 1. Steps before it are complete and steps after it upcoming; a step's own state overrides that (error). Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model.

props.name: orientation
props.description: A row with connectors between the steps, or a column with the connector down the side and room for longer descriptions. Emitted as data-orientation.

props.name: clickable
props.description: Lets people go back to a completed step: its title becomes a button that reports value-change. Upcoming steps stay plain text.
props.a11y: Only completed steps become buttons, so people can't skip ahead.

props.name: label
props.description: The list's accessible name, such as "Checkout progress".

props.name: completeLabel
props.description: The visually hidden text in a complete step's marker, so the state isn't only a check icon. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Completed' ).

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: The visually hidden text in an error step's marker. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Error' ).

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, children included, such as { marker: '…', title: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The ordered list of steps. It is the spec's list part.

parts.name: step
parts.description: One step, with data-state complete, current, upcoming or error. The current step has aria-current="step".

parts.name: marker
parts.description: The circle: the step's number, a check when complete, an x on error, or its icon. Complete and error carry visually hidden text.

parts.name: title
parts.description: The step's name. A button on completed steps when clickable.

parts.name: connector
parts.description: The line to the next step, filled once the step is complete. Hidden from assistive technology and not drawn after the last step.

events.name: value-change
events.description: A completed step was chosen while clickable. The payload is its number. Setting value doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: Moves through the completed steps' buttons, when clickable. Otherwise Steps has no stops.
Goes back to the focused completed step.

requirements: An ordered list, so the count and position are announced.
Complete and error steps carry visually hidden text (completeLabel, errorLabel), not only an icon.
Markers and connectors meet 3:1 against the surface; titles and descriptions 4.5:1.
Only completed steps are buttons when clickable; upcoming steps can't be reached.
